fix_commit_title: KVM: create_vcpu: check id against KVM_MAX_VCPUS
before_commit: upstream parent of the fix (traceable via the CVE-2013-4587 patch); exact hash pending verification
guard_note: The fix is an input-validation guard `if (id >= KVM_MAX_VCPUS) return -EINVAL;`. The downstream OOB (vcpu_id used as an array index elsewhere in KVM) is not reachable from this unit, so the harness observes whether kvm_arch_vcpu_create is called with an out-of-range id. KVM_MAX_VCPUS stubbed to 4 (upstream 1024).

cases.note: id=3 < KVM_MAX_VCPUS=4: every variant proceeds to kvm_arch_vcpu_create
id=4 == KVM_MAX_VCPUS: before/ineffective proceed (guard bypassed), after/equivalent return -EINVAL
id=5 > KVM_MAX_VCPUS: only before proceeds; after/ineffective/equivalent reject
